issues.message: Confirmed. Month-end means the last Monday-through-Friday date of the calendar month using the Europe/London entry date. It is a reporting-only robustness tag and never changes entries, exits, or parameter selection.

Confirmed. The requested doubled-cost stress recomputes net R with each trade's spread, commission, and slippage multiplied by 2. Same-day trades have no swap. V2 may also report its standard 1.5x stress separately and must label the two levels distinctly.

Confirmed. Without an authoritative London-fix holiday calendar, every weekday containing the required [16:02,16:03) Europe/London M1 bar trades. The specification's holiday-contamination flag means the limitation must be disclosed at result level; it does not require an unavailable per-day holiday tag or change the trading rule.
